assets.title: Wonderland
assets.alt: An aged-parchment map of Wonderland framed in playing-card suits. North, a great dark rabbit hole spills cards toward the Rabbit Warren and its Pool of Tears. West lies the Tulgey Wood, its dark trees carrying grinning Cheshire faces. North-east stands the Mad Tea Quarter under a broken clock tower. South-east, behind red-flagged walls, sits the Queen's Domain and the Palace of Hearts. A river winds down the middle; the compass rose points This Way, Other Way and Back Again.
assets.showWhen: The party consults a map, asks where they are, plans a journey between regions, or first arrives in the Rabbit Warren, the Tulgey Wood, the Mad Tea Quarter or the Queen's Domain.

assets.title: The Cheshire Cat
assets.alt: A disembodied crescent grin with gleaming teeth, hanging in dark branches.
assets.showWhen: The Cheshire Cat appears or speaks for the first time in a scene.
